newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends soft at 477.25/478.25/dlr.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends soft at 477.25/478.25/dlr.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed soft at 477.25/478.25 per dollar in moderate trade, traders said.
The Central Bank intervened "but only gently and only enough to supply most of the market's dollar needs," said one trader.
Brokers added most of the dollar demand was from corporate clients.
The unit closed last Wednesday -- the most recent day of trade before the Easter holidays -- at 477.00/478.00 per dollar.
